summary: Completed full testing of Centro de Control Recipients Manager feature. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tested successfully - Notificaciones tab shows recipients list, add form, and CRUD operations work correctly. Email and WhatsApp notification services now read recipients from MongoDB instead of .env.
critical_code_review_comments: Recipients CRUD operations properly implemented in recipients_manager.py with MongoDB storage
Email and WhatsApp notification services correctly read from MongoDB with fallback to .env
All endpoints properly protected with authentication (get_current_user dependency)
Phone number formatting to E.164 format implemented for WhatsApp recipients
Duplicate recipient validation prevents adding same email/phone twice
Frontend Notificaciones tab provides complete UI for managing recipients
WebSocket connection for real-time notifications working correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipients Manager feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) MongoDB collection 'alert_recipients' stores recipients. 2) GET /destinatarios returns list with filtering by tipo and solo_activos. 3) POST /destinatarios creates new recipient with validation. 4) PUT /destinatarios/{id} toggles active status or updates name. 5) DELETE /destinatarios/{id} removes recipient. 6) GET /destinatarios/resumen returns summary by type. 7) Email and WhatsApp services read from MongoDB first, fallback to .env. 8) Frontend Notificaciones tab provides full CRUD UI.

GET_centro_control_destinatarios.details: Returns list of recipients with filtering by tipo (email/whatsapp) and solo_activos

POST_centro_control_destinatarios.details: Creates email or whatsapp recipient. Validates type, formats phone numbers, rejects duplicates

PUT_centro_control_destinatarios_id.details: Updates recipient active status or name. Returns 400 for nonexistent ID

DELETE_centro_control_destinatarios_id.details: Deletes recipient. Returns 404 for nonexistent ID

GET_centro_control_destinatarios_resumen.details: Returns summary with count and masked recipients by type

email_notifications_reads_mongodb.details: GET /email/config shows recipients_count from MongoDB (1 email recipient)

whatsapp_notifications_reads_mongodb.details: GET /whatsapp/config shows recipients_count from MongoDB (1 whatsapp recipient)

frontend_notificaciones_tab.details: Tab shows Email/WhatsApp/WebSocket status cards, add form, recipients list with Desactivar/Eliminar buttons

frontend_add_recipient.details: Form with type selector, email/phone input, name input, Agregar button. Toast confirms success

frontend_delete_recipient.details: Eliminar button with confirmation dialog. Toast confirms deletion

mocked_integrations.note: No mocked integrations - all APIs use real MongoDB storage
